* Realisations of [[wikipedia:Grue and bleen|''grue and bleen'']] proposed by Curtis W. Fraŋks
*:'''Grue''' and '''bleen''' are predicates coined by [[wikipedia:Nelson Goodman|Nelson Goodman]] in ''[[wikipedia:Fact, Fiction, and Forecast|Fact, Fiction, and Forecast]]'' to illustrate "the new [[wikipedia:Problem of induction|riddle of induction]]". These predicates are unusual because their application to things are time dependent.
** '''clinu'''
**: x1 is grue, associated with time x2.
**:'''fabu crino pu febu ije fabu blanu ba febu'''
** '''brano'''
**: x1 is bleen, associated with time x2.
**:'''fabu blanu pu febu ije fabu crino ba febu'''
